title: Bella's Colorful Garden Adventure
summary: Today, Bella finds a special place filled with flowers. She teaches Baby Leo and Bobo about colors. Together, they explore and learn to share the beautiful flowers with each other.
lesson: Kids learn about different colors in nature.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, and Bobo explore a sunny garden full of colorful flowers. They notice how beautiful everything is.
Bella says, 'Look at all the colors! What is your favorite?' Baby Leo shouts, 'I like the red ones!'
Bobo is shy but shares, 'I love the blue flowers!' Bella smiles and suggests they collect a flower of each color.
They start picking flowers together, but then Bobo accidentally knocks over a pot! Uh-oh!
Bella makes a clever plan to gather all the flowers safely. 'Let's take turns,' she says.
Baby Leo and Bobo listen and help each other. They carefully collect the flowers and put them in a basket.
With their colorful flowers, they create a beautiful picture together on the grass.
Twinkle arrives and sprinkles sparkles, making their flower picture glow in the sunlight.
They all cheer and talk about their favorite colors, feeling happy and proud.
Baby Leo, Bella, and Bobo promise to play in the garden again and share what they learned.
